from solution import max_difference


def test_issue_example():
    """Example [(3,5),(1,7),(10,3),(1,2)] has maximum difference 7."""
    assert max_difference([(3, 5), (1, 7), (10, 3), (1, 2)]) == 7  # |3-5|=2, |1-7|=6, |10-3|=7, |1-2|=1 -> max 7


def test_issue_single_pair():
    """Maximum difference of single pair [(5,1)] is 4."""
    assert max_difference([(5, 1)]) == 4  # |5-1|=4 -> max 4


def test_issue_second_larger_absolute():
    """Difference uses absolute value so [(1,7),(2,5)] gives 6."""
    assert max_difference([(1, 7), (2, 5)]) == 6  # |1-7|=6, |2-5|=3 -> max 6


def test_issue_zero_difference():
    """Pairs with equal elements [(4,4),(5,5)] give maximum 0."""
    assert max_difference([(4, 4), (5, 5)]) == 0  # |4-4|=0, |5-5|=0 -> max 0


def test_issue_negative_and_cross_zero():
    """Negative values [(-10,5),(-5,-1)] give maximum 15."""
    assert max_difference([(-10, 5), (-5, -1)]) == 15  # |-10-5|=15, |-5-(-1)|=4 -> max 15


def test_issue_large_values():
    """Large values [(1000000,1),(2,3)] give maximum 999999."""
    assert max_difference([(1000000, 1), (2, 3)]) == 999999  # |1000000-1|=999999, |2-3|=1 -> max 999999


def test_issue_tied_maximum():
    """Tied maxima [(1,5),(5,1),(2,2)] give maximum 4."""
    assert max_difference([(1, 5), (5, 1), (2, 2)]) == 4  # |1-5|=4, |5-1|=4, |2-2|=0 -> max 4


def test_issue_zero_involved():
    """Pairs involving zero [(0,10),(0,0)] give maximum 10."""
    assert max_difference([(0, 10), (0, 0)]) == 10  # |0-10|=10, |0-0|=0 -> max 10


def test_contract_callable():
    """Function max_difference takes a tuple list."""
    assert callable(max_difference)  # must be callable with test_list


def test_contract_does_not_mutate():
    """Function must not mutate the input list."""
    data = [(3, 5), (1, 7)]
    snapshot = [(3, 5), (1, 7)]
    max_difference(data)
    assert data == snapshot


def test_contract_returns_number():
    """Result is a number giving the maximum difference."""
    result = max_difference([(3, 5)])
    assert isinstance(result, (int, float))  # |3-5|=2 -> numeric result
